rec.name: Auto-Rotating Image Carousel (Hero Slider with Text and CTA)
rec.status: Built — internally tested, documented (Slite); product image created

what.text: A full-width image slider section that automatically cycles through slides. Each slide has a background image, a centered heading, a short subtext and a button. In the screenshot the slide shows the heading 'Corgi', the subtext 'Corgis sind die coolsten Hunde' and a black 'GET A CORGI' button over a darkened background image.

why.text: A carousel lets one prominent hero area carry several messages (USPs, campaigns, categories) without adding page length. Each slide pairs a visual with a clear CTA, which gives visitors a direct next step. The dark image overlay keeps white text legible. Auto-rotation creates movement that draws attention, but carousels often get weak engagement on later slides, so the strongest message should go first. Commenters also asked for a way to see how many slides remain and to jump back to a previous slide, which fits the principle of giving users control and orientation.

how.text: Add the section from the theme editor on the homepage (under 'Sections'). For each slide, upload an image, enter heading and text, and set the button label and link. The slider advances automatically from image to image. Per the ticket, no metafield is needed and non-developers can set it up. Internal testers confirmed it works and looks good. The auto-advance interval was entered as a setting in version 1.1 (the first tester could not find one initially).

items: Auto-advance interval (added in v1.1 per comment; exact range not documented)
Open question: customer swipe on mobile (asked by a tester, no answer in the ticket)
Requested but unconfirmed: slide indicators (dots/counter) or previous-slide navigation

dependencies.text: No metafield required (ticket field 'MF/N'). Built as a Sectionfy section in the 'sectionfy.io (Test Christoph)' theme; relies on the section system and theme editor, with no app. The ticket marks installation by non-developers as possible.

items: Click-through rate on slide CTA buttons
CTR per slide position (to see whether later slides get any engagement)
Click-through to collection or product pages from the hero
Conversion rate and revenue per session for homepage-entry sessions

images.caption: Carousel slide: dark background image with centered heading 'Corgi', subtext and black 'GET A CORGI' button.
